F1: When no destination calendar is set, `handleNewBooking.ts:1063-1067` passes `null`, so `mainHostDestinationCalendar` is undefined and `.integration` at `EventManager.ts:119` throws for Google Meet bookings.
F2: EventManager.ts:170` now drops `credentialId` from every video reference, and `handleCancelBooking.ts:491` only deletes a video meeting when that ID is present, so cancelled bookings leave their meetings running.
F3: CalendarManager.createEvent` hands each host's credential the full destination array, and Office365 (`CalendarService.ts:73-77`), Lark and CalDAV always pick the first entry, so other hosts' credentials are pointed at the main host's calendar.
F4: The fallback only runs when `externalCalendarId` is missing, yet it searches for `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId`, so it never matches: updates get an undefined `calendarId` and deletes silently fall back to `"primary"`.
F5: The recurring branch, now inside the per-reference loop, only uses the owner's credentials and only the first `_calendar` reference of each updated booking, so co-hosts' events created by the new multi-destination flow are never deleted.
F6: With billing disabled, `create.handler.ts:151-153` stores neither `slug` nor `requestedSlug`, but `publish.handler.ts:54` needs `requestedSlug` and `createTeams.handler.ts:67` needs one of the two, so onboarding breaks.
